# Review - PR 299 @ b79f4bb0ffb9f73b19939121f3ced8d9f7e3a020

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: `ea5d5d9f19c9cd2de43fa12414deeb58bd198bef` (github/main). Large construction packet, +2920/-9 against merge base `096ca2b8f33719c93ff5aafb3789d9f080e84e69` on `main`: four new Lean modules and the final proof that discharges the single `sorry` of `exists_spcc_value_one`, two visibility/documentation changes in the Magic Square support files, one construction audit and two blueprint chapters.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope reviewed. The base is `main`, so no stacked-base handling was needed; the worktree HEAD equals the published head `b79f4bb0` and the tree is clean. I read the whole main-relative diff: `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Completeness.lean`, the four new modules (`Completeness/HonestStrategy.lean`, `Completeness/HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean`, `Completeness/Commutation.lean`, `Completeness/Rejection.lean`), the two Magic Square files, `audits/2026-09-07_honest-pauli-strategy-recovery.md`, and the `ch13`/`ch14` blueprint changes.

Statement integrity. `exists_spcc_value_one` keeps the pre-existing public statement from `main`; the diff replaces only its proof. I re-elaborated it at this head: `exists_spcc_value_one : ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams), ∃ S, S.IsSPCC ∧ S.toStrategy.value = 1`. Paper assumptions (`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1232-1234`, "The Pauli basis test ... has a value-$1$ SPCC strategy"): an admissible tuple. Lean assumptions: `P : AdmissibleParams` only. Paper conclusion and Lean conclusion: existence of an SPCC strategy of value one. Verdict: exact. No bridge, residual, package, producer, witness or proof-obligation input is added anywhere on the route, and the two Magic Square files change only `private` to `theorem` plus docstrings, with hypotheses and proof bodies untouched. Anti-patterns A1-A6: none applies. `pauliWinPredicate`, `pauliQuestionDistribution`, `pauliEdges` and the value definition are all outside this diff, so the value-one claim cannot be trivialised from inside the packet.

Proof integrity, verified directly. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or linter-suppressing `set_option` occurs in any changed Lean file (the only `set_option` uses are two `maxRecDepth 8000`). On the built worktree I ran `lake env lean` on a probe importing `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness`: `#print axioms` for `exists_spcc_value_one`, `honestStrategy_isSPCC` and `honestMeasurement_rejected_mul` each returns exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Exact-head CI is green: `local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed (389s)", with build, proof-debt, proof-evasion, file-length, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync and paper-gaps all success.

Mathematics checked, not only re-run. The value-one argument is genuine and complete: `honestMeasurement_rejected_mul` reduces every supported question pair to one of four cases via `pauliQuestionDistribution_pos_incidence` and `pauliEdges_cases` (self-loop, Magic Square edge, oriented incidence, reversed incidence), and `pauliEdges_cases` is proved by unfolding `pauliEdges` itself, so the case list cannot silently omit an edge. Self-loops use projector orthogonality; the shared-basis edges (Point/ALine, Point/DLine, Point/Pauli, Point/Pair-W, Point/Variable) go through `placedBasis_rejected_mul`, which needs a genuine acceptance proof for every Pauli label - `honest_alinePointCondition` and `honest_dlinePointCondition` supply the real line-evaluation content via `evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding` and `evalCoefficient_restrictToLine`. The Pair-W/Pair edge uses commuting trace effects for vanishing phase and the one-sided gate otherwise, and the Magic Square edges are delegated to `msStrategyMeasurement_rejected_mul_on_support` with all its cell hypotheses derived internally from `obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute`. Born weights are then killed by `heteroKron_mulVec_epr_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero` using effect symmetry, and normalisation by `outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one`; nothing here is a conclusion-shaped hypothesis. The observable identity `obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement` reproduces `eq:finally-got-an-observable` at paper lines 1300-1315, and `obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_mul_comm` reproduces the `(-1)^\gamma` law at 1316-1330.

Deliberate divergence. When `\gamma \neq 0` the source (paper lines 1352-1357) makes `E^{(Pair,X)}` and `E^{(Pair,Z)}` trivial together with the joint Pair measurement, while `honestPairWMeasurement` keeps the trace measurements in that case. This changes only the existential witness, not a hypothesis or a conclusion, and it is sound: the Pair checks accept automatically for nonzero phase, and the retained measurements remain projective, EPR-consistent and commuting on every incident edge, all of which is proved rather than assumed. It is documented in the Lean docstring, in the blueprint note added at `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:1494-1503`, and in the audit's statement-integrity section.

Reuse and duplication. I grepped `github/main` for every new public name (`restrictToAxisLine`, `evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding`, `pauliTraceBit`, `pauliTraceMeasurement`, `pauliBasisMeasurement`, `pauliPairEffect`, `pauliProj_nonneg`, `pauliProj_conjTranspose`, `pauliProj_isProj`, `tauObservable_transpose`, `unitMeasurement`, `deterministicMeasurement`, `leftPlaced_commute`, `postprocess_effect_commute`, `placedPauliMeasurement`, `HonestIndex`, `pauliAnswerOfMs`, `PauliEdgeOriented`, `pauliEdges_cases`, `honestStrategy`): none collides with an existing declaration. `restrictToAxisLine` is not a duplicate of `restrictToLine` - it is the degree-`d` truncation the axis-line answer type requires, and its degree bound is discharged from `polynomialOnLine_lowDegreeEncoding_natDegree_le_one_of_axis`. Every new public declaration carries a docstring, and the paper locators I sampled check out against the mirror (the strategy specification begins at 1237, `A` and `B` at 1281-1286, the pair definition at 1331-1344).

Prior findings. Round-1 F1/F2 and all nine round-2 findings were already resolved before this head, and I re-confirmed the ones with lasting artefacts: the locators are `1237-1360` and `1277-1286`, the formerly bare effect and symmetry lemmas carry docstrings, the audit has the underscore filename and the required YAML front matter, the `Assembly` module is now `HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean`, the constructor-shaped and "fibre-collapse" wording is gone, and the five newly public Magic Square lemmas open with "Formalization-only auxiliary ...". The two round-3 findings of review 5236179634 are resolved at this head by commit `b79f4bb0`: `pauliBasisMeasurement_effect_transpose` is deleted and its call site now passes `pauliProj_transpose W` against the explicit `pauliBasisMeasurement W`, and the dead `variable {K ι : Type*} ...` block is removed; nothing else changed.

Prose lane. The new proof-level `\leanok` on `lem:pauli-completeness` is valid, the proof being `sorry`-free with a clean axiom closure, and the two added `\lean{...}` names resolve to proved declarations. The rewritten `\gamma = 1` sentence now matches the formal witness, and the following paragraph states the divergence from the source in plain mathematics, which is the location `docs/mathematical_language.md` prescribes for a representation difference confined to the blueprint. The `ch14` addition ("this degree-$d$ list has the same coefficient-list evaluation $g_h(u)$ at every $u\in\ell$") is exactly what `evalCoefficient_restrictToAxisLine_lowDegreeEncoding` proves under the same axis-parallel hypothesis, and the added `\uses{lem:low-degree-encoding-line-restriction}` matches a real dependency. I found no Lean jargon in the new prose and no claim of proof for anything unproved.

One non-blocking observation, recorded rather than raised as a finding because it concerns PR metadata and not the repository content: the PR body has only Motivation and Description, where `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md:38` and `.github/pull_request_template.md` ask for three sections, and its Description is the raw commit list rather than a statement of what changed. The substantive equivalent - definitions introduced, deviation from the paper, and the validation performed - is present in `audits/2026-09-07_honest-pauli-strategy-recovery.md`, so no in-repo information is missing; a merge-time body refresh would settle it.

Not checked: I did not run a full `lake build` or re-render the blueprint (I relied on the green exact-head CI for those), I did not re-derive the 852-line rejection case analysis symbol by symbol beyond reading it and confirming its axiom closure, and I did not audit declarations outside the diff.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
